title.orig: An Act Declaring October Nineteen of Every Year a Special Nonworking Public Holiday in the City of Bacolod to Be Known as "Bacolod City Charter Day"

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1994/ra_7724_1994.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: October Nineteen is the Charter Day Anniversary of the City of Bacolod and its celebration is highlighted, with the staging of the now famous Maskara Festival.
October Nineteen of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking public holiday in the City of Bacolod.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, May 19, 1994.
